newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Montgomery cuts VLSI.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Montgomery cuts VLSI.

text.p: -- Montgomery Securities cut its 1997 earnings estimate on VLSI Technology Inc to $1.30 from $1.40 per share, trading sources said.
-- Montgomery analyst Clark Westmont was not immediately available to comment. The brokerage could not confirm the changes.

-- The downgrade followed the company's fourth quarter earnings release Thursday evening, which, while in line with Wall Street's consensus expectations, failed to meet informal, "whispered" expectations, market sources said.
-- VLSI stock tumbled $3-1/8 to 20-1/8 in heavy early afternoon trade, ahead of a conference call with analysts scheduled to start at 1300 EST 1800 GMT.
